dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Faint, blurry pale margins are visible along the distal edges of the folded flight feathers against the uniform gray ground color.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, large white spots arranged in transverse bands across the dark tail feathers; a distinct orange-rufous plumage patch is visible on the flank or lower wing area.
